trusted_statements: BrushRuntime is the single semantic evaluator and emits renderer-neutral BrushPrimitive artifacts.
Arc consumes render-ready primitives and does not interpret brush semantics.
BrushDefinition v1/v2 semantics, canonical StrokeRecord, G4.4 input arbitration and accepted G4.5 behavior remain unchanged.
Shape and Grain are stable renderer-neutral resource bindings.
The accepted Skia SDK supply chain is locked by r1-full-skia-sdk.lock.json and must be consumed, not rebuilt.
scope_addition: This package adds only the cross-platform renderer integration and parity qualification needed to consume the existing BrushPrimitive programmable-DAB output on Android and Web through Skia.
